decisions.choice: Keep scheduling, visibility, darkness constraints, and endpoint mapping as separately packaged features.
decisions.reason: The proof must exercise direct CShells feature composition and explicit dependency boundaries.

decisions.choice: Define task contracts in Core and register handlers, middleware, occurrence factories, and schedules in FirstAvailable.
decisions.reason: The feature owns the work behavior while Core remains runtime-independent.

decisions.choice: Use the exact Cronos 0.13 provider behind Program Kit schedule contracts.
decisions.reason: The fixture needs one source-verified lightweight CRON calculation without making CRON universal task semantics.

decisions.choice: Use one owned typed converter and source-generated metadata contribution; do not expose JsonElement or JsonNode.
decisions.reason: Serialization must remain predictable, canonicalizable, and model-first.

decisions.choice: Drain accepted v1 task instances on their v1 handler before activating the v2 handler and recreate future occurrences from the v2 schedule.
decisions.reason: Accepted work retains the exact semantics under which it was accepted.
